note: Environment variable names read by the public-docs pages (changelog, docs, ui, visualizations), their layouts and proxy.ts. Names only; values match the Vercel platform project unless listed under unset. NEXT_PUBLIC_* names are inlined at build time, so the CI build job needs them too.
publicBuildAndRuntime: NEXT_PUBLIC_<APP>_APP_URL for CHAT, CMS, CONTACTS, DRIVE, FINANCE, FORMS, LEARN, MAIL, MEET, PAY, TASKS, TEACH, TOOLS, TRACK, TUDO
runtimeConfig: <APP>_APP_URL and TUTURUUU_<APP>_BASE_URL for the app list above

unset.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY: The changelog reads published entries with the publishable-key client; no admin client in the family.
unset.TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET: No app-coordination routes in the family.
unset.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN: No Upstash store: the proxy abuse guard logs abuse-guard-store-missing once per isolate and serves the public pages without a rate-limit store.
unset.VERCEL: Selects Vercel client-IP trust; the Worker trusts cf-connecting-ip only.
unset.TRUSTED_PROXY_ORIGIN_SECRET: Used only by TRUSTED_PROXY=cloudflare-origin on Vercel.
unset.PLATFORM_LOG_DRAIN_DATABASE_URL: Would open a Postgres TCP connection from lib/infrastructure/log-drain.ts.
unset.CRON_SECRET: No cron routes in this family.
unset.VERCEL_CRON_SECRET: No cron routes in this family.
unset.SUPABASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: No webhook routes in this family.
unset.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: Legacy alias of SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY; S1 confirms it is unused before cutover.
